title: neltuma campestris
intro: Neltuma campestris, commonly known as the 'Wild Horsemint', is a perennial plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of Neltuma campestris include its ability to ease digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its calming effects on the nervous system, relieving stress and anxiety, as well as its antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Neltuma campestris include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
